thread:
anita.k: Heads-up — deploy-bot started a staged rollout for embed-service v2.14.0 at 18:00 UTC (change window). Initial traffic shift 10%. I see a small error bump, tagging @michael_r @jen to eyeball dashboards.
deploy-bot: [automated] rollout step: embed-service v2.14.0 -> traffic 10%. Runbook: /playbooks/deploy-observability. Notify: eng-platform, eng-oncall.
michael_r: copying dashboards — can you grab p95/p99 and SLO % from the embed SLO dashboard? also any spike in 5xx codes?
jen: dashboard: https://obs.redwood.internal/d/embeds/rollout-watch?orgId=1 (shortlink) — p95 +12ms vs baseline, p99 shows a transient ~400ms spike, error rate 0.8% (baseline ~0.2%). 5xx increased by 0.3% over baseline in the last 3m.
observability-bot: ALERT: embeds.request.error_rate > 0.5% (5m window) — triggered at 5578901302. Related traces: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/abcd1234.
samir: thanks. looks like a small NPE in the new decoder path on certain prompt shapes — I've pulled a couple traces. Suggest pause traffic shift and pin routing for heavy-embed customers back to v2.13.7 while we triage.
anita.k: decision point — pause+investigate or rollback full? we prefer pause if safe. what's the risk of leaving 10% on the new version?
michael_r: risk is user-facing 5xxs for a subset of traffic. If pause is instant and we route stable traffic to v2.13.7 (pin), we avoid full rollback. I recommend pause and pin for now.
jen: I'll update routing rules — running command: `redwood route pin --service embed-service --to v2.13.7 --selector high-qps-customers` — will also set traffic to 0% for v2.14.0.
deploy-bot: [automated] rollout paused by anita.k at 5578901360. Current traffic for v2.14.0 set to 0%.
anita.k: Samir, team — triage priority P0 on repro. If fix is >30m, we'll cut a hotfix release. Can product/sdks update release notes to call out the bug and rollback plan?
samir: reproducer captured, working on root cause. I can push a patch branch within 20m.
jen: adding a note to the release notes and the changelog: "v2.14.0: rolling pause due to embed decoder NPE on certain prompts; customers on v2.13.7 unaffected; hotfix in progress." Also created ticket RED-7892 and linked incident doc.
michael_r: verifying SLOs — once traffic dropped to 0% for the bad version, errors should drop back to baseline. I'll monitor p95/p99 for the next 10m and call rollback if anything else pops.
anita.k: thanks all — update slack when you have a fix or if we need to escalate to rollback/rollback-forced. Also ping legal/compliance if any customer-facing incidents might be needed. :thumbsup:
observability-bot: SLO snapshot (post-pause): embeds.request.error_rate now 0.18% (5m), p99 trending down. Snapshot link: https://obs.redwood.internal/snapshots/5578901400
michael_r: looks stable. marking this thread as paused-rollout, no full rollback required at this time.
jen: incident doc updated, release notes saved, routing pinned. I'll follow up with a short postmortem once root cause fixed.
anita.k: ack — closing active watch. If fix lands, we'll schedule a controlled re-rollout with tighter sampling and canary traffic at 5% first.
